    typ = get_type(arg, max_typed_dict_size=self.max_typed_dict_size)
    last_opcode = frame.f_code.co_code[frame.f_lasti]
    trace = self.traces.get(frame)
    if trace is None:
        return
    elif last_opcode == YIELD_VALUE_OPCODE:
